{'text': '新款 Apple TV 4K 將於明天在 Apple「歡迎回家」發布會上亮相。以下是據傳它將帶來的五項升級。', 'paragraph_context': 'A new Apple TV 4K will be unveiled tomorrow as part of Apple’s ‘Welcome home’ event. Here are five upgrades it’s rumored to bring.'}

{'text': '以下是新 Apple TV 4K 據傳帶來的所有升級', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s every rumored upgrade the new Apple TV 4K will bring'}

{'text': 'Apple 將於本周二（10 月 13 日）舉行「歡迎回家」發布會，屆時將推出多款期待已久的家居產品。', 'paragraph_context': 'This Tuesday, October 13 Apple is holding its ‘Welcome home’ event where it will unveil several long-awaited Home products.'}

{'text': '其中一款就是新 Apple TV 4K，是該裝置自 2022 年以來的首次更新。', 'paragraph_context': 'One of those is a new Apple TV 4K, the first update to the device since 2022.'}

{'text': '以下是據報將推出的五項新功能：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here are five new features reportedly coming:'}

  • {'text': 'A19 晶片，升級自現有的 A15 Bionic', 'paragraph_context': 'A19 chip, up from the current A15 Bionic'}
  • {'text': 'Siri AI', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri AI'}
  • {'text': 'Apple TV 機身內置麥克風，用於 Siri', 'paragraph_context': 'Microphone built into Apple TV box for Siri'}
  • {'text': '全新 Siri Remote，配備內置揚聲器', 'paragraph_context': 'Updated Siri Remote with built-in speaker'}
  • {'text': 'N1 無線晶片', 'paragraph_context': 'N1 wireless chip'}

{'text': 'A19 晶片應該會令 Apple TV 4K 運作比現有硬件更順暢，並較 2022 年型號的 A15 有顯著提升。更重要的是，它還會加入對 Siri AI 的支援。', 'paragraph_context': 'The A19 chip should make the Apple TV 4K run smoother than current hardware, and offer a significant upgrade over the A15 in the 2022 model. It will importantly also add support for Siri AI.'}

{'text': '從上述功能列表可以清楚看到，Siri AI 是新 Apple TV 的核心重點。', 'paragraph_context': 'As is clear from the list of features above, Siri AI is a central focus of the new Apple TV.'}

{'text': 'Siri 不僅會獲得軟件上的改進，由於 Apple TV 4K 機身內置了麥克風，操作起來亦會更加方便。', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri won’t merely get a software improvement. It will also be easier to interact with thanks to the built-in microphone in the Apple TV 4K box.'}

{'text': 'RDW 的熱門留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by RDW'}

{'text': '代朋友問問......為甚麼他們要把咪高峰內置於機身而不是遙控器？很多人（包括我本人）都會將機頂盒放在櫃內，並透過遙控器與裝置溝通。', 'paragraph_context': 'Asking for a friend...So why would they build the mic into the box itself instead of the remote? A lot of people (including myself) have their boxes in a cabinet and use the remote to communicate with the unit.'}

{'text': '類似 HomePod，這樣就可以純粹用語音與 Siri 互動，毋須按下 Siri Remote 上的按鍵。我估計你甚至可以叫 Siri 幫你找回遙控器，Siri 會在新 Siri Remote 上發出聲響，方便你找到遺留的位置。', 'paragraph_context': 'Similar to a HomePod, this will enable interacting with Siri entirely by voice, with no need to hit the button on the Siri Remote. I suspect you’ll even be able to ask Siri to find the remote, and it will play a noise on the new Siri Remote so you can find where you left it.'}

{'text': 'N1 無線晶片預計可提升 AirDrop 等功能的穩定性，並可能與其他 Apple Home 相關的功能改進互相配合。', 'paragraph_context': 'The N1 wireless chip is expected to enable improved reliability with features like AirDrop, and could tie into other Apple Home-related feature improvements.'}

{'text': '除上述五項升級外，Apple 隨時可能為我們帶來驚喜，推出一些目前尚未曝光的新功能。我們將於本周持續為大家報道所有發布內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'Beyond these five upgrades, Apple could always surprise us with new features that haven’t yet been rumored. We’ll keep you posted on all the announcements as they unfold this week.'}

{'text': '你打算將手上的 Apple TV 4K 升級至新型號嗎？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。', 'paragraph_context': 'Are you planning to upgrade your Apple TV 4K to the new model? Let us know in the comments.'}
